exposure: age gap to the nearest older sibling
cohort: Children <5 years of age in Denmark
finding: Having a slightly older sibling, particularly with a short age gap, was associated with an increased risk of HPeV-3 infections, but not other HPeV infections.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not associated with the risk of HPeV infections.
birth_weight: Assessed but not associated with HPeV infection
